notes.title: Visual Update!!
notes.notes: Progress has been a little slow, but we've revamped some of the visuals! Less particles and more animations means MUCH less lag if you had that issue before. The fourth boss has had a major upgrade in function and patterns so its a lot more enjoyable to fight. Other small bug fixes and a control layout in the settings menu have been added. 3 more levels are in the works at the moment so be expecting those soon!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: The initial launch had a couple of issues, including the 3rd unlockable ship not working. These among others have been fixed and more work is being done to further improve your experience. Thank you to everyone who has checked out the game so far, you have much more to look forward to!
